estimates.assumptions: 2 tbs olive oil = 30 ml total; pure oil has no carbohydrates
8 spring onions ≈ 120 g total edible portion; using standard green onion values
200 g raw spinach; full quantity as provided
4 standard filo sheets (≈ 200 g total); all pastry used, based on typical filo carb density
1 standard drained can of tuna in water/brine ≈ 140-160 g drained; plain tuna has no carbs
2 large whole raw eggs (≈ 100 g total); trace carbs from eggs
Dash of hot sauce is negligible volume; cannot reasonably estimate exact contribution
4 medium chopped tomatoes ≈ 500 g total edible portion for salad
1/4 medium cucumber ≈ 75 g edible portion for salad
1 tbs lemon juice ≈ 15 ml; using standard lemon juice values
4 tbs apricot jam ≈ 80 g total (served as chutney accompaniment); typical sweetened jam values
